seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves +-5 on A1-4; invisible maze walls {(39,5),(34,10)} block it; portal (9,5)->(34,5).
step_bar: -2 per action incl. no-ops, x=55-w, tag str(w); refuel ring fully covered by player is consumed and bar refills to 42.
Collect target (diamond) fully covered by the player is not extracted; it reappears when uncovered (continuity-gated hidden memory).
All other types (legend, recolor_token, hud_glyph, ring_31_20) treated as static scenery.
Unconfirmed: maze cells beyond the observed ones, board bounds (assumed 0..59), bar behaviour at 0, clicks/A5/A7 (treated as bar-only).
